blocks.html: Talk to Ali the Wise in Nardah (north-most building).
blocks.text: Talk to Ali the Wise in Nardah (north-most building).

options.text: Time for me to go to Trollweiss, then.

substeps.html: To get there: teleport to fairy ring DLQ and run south.
substeps.text: To get there: teleport to fairy ring DLQ and run south.

substeps.html: Or teleport to Al Kharid and go south to Shantay Pass, then take a magic carpet to Nardah.
substeps.text: Or teleport to Al Kharid and go south to Shantay Pass, then take a magic carpet to Nardah.

blocks.html: Head to the snowy area northwest of Trollheim, enter the troll tunnels and head north to go through the tunnels, and then head to the east to Ritual plateau tunnels.
blocks.text: Head to the snowy area northwest of Trollheim, enter the troll tunnels and head north to go through the tunnels, and then head to the east to Ritual plateau tunnels.

substeps.html: Follow the directions on the map below to get to the Ritual plateau tunnels, or use Trollheim Teleport if you have it. If you travel through Death Plateau or Troll Stronghold, you must bring the climbing boots.
substeps.text: Follow the directions on the map below to get to the Ritual plateau tunnels, or use Trollheim Teleport if you have it. If you travel through Death Plateau or Troll Stronghold, you must bring the climbing boots.

substeps.html: Prepare for combat before going through Trollheim as you don't have any access to bank in there.
substeps.text: Prepare for combat before going through Trollheim as you don't have any access to bank in there.

needed.html: 7 backpack spaces and equipment to fight Arrav
needed.text: 7 backpack spaces and equipment to fight Arrav

blocks.html: Navigate through the caves by mining the rubble; some rubble must be mined from multiple sides to clear it.
blocks.text: Navigate through the caves by mining the rubble; some rubble must be mined from multiple sides to clear it.

substeps.html: Optional: pick up the stone, granite, slate, and shale tablets.
substeps.text: Optional: pick up the stone, granite, slate, and shale tablets.

substeps.html: Optional: Search the small bookcase for notes (a-j) if you want to give all information to Ali the Wise after the quest is completed. There is no reward for doing so.
substeps.text: Optional: Search the small bookcase for notes (a-j) if you want to give all information to Ali the Wise after the quest is completed. There is no reward for doing so.

blocks.html: Enter the room east of the caves.
blocks.text: Enter the room east of the caves.

blocks.html: Climb the stairs.
blocks.text: Climb the stairs.

blocks.html: Talk to Arrav, who will attack you immediately.
blocks.text: Talk to Arrav, who will attack you immediately.

substeps.html: After he starts attacking you, if you do not auto-retaliate, right-click and attack him.
substeps.text: After he starts attacking you, if you do not auto-retaliate, right-click and attack him.

blocks.html: Fight until he teleports away. The fight will pause multiple times for dialogue.
blocks.text: Fight until he teleports away. The fight will pause multiple times for dialogue.

blocks.html: Enter the room to the south and search the tapestry on the west wall for base key and base plans.
blocks.text: Enter the room to the south and search the tapestry on the west wall for base key and base plans.

blocks.html: Travel back to Nardah and speak to Ali the Wise.
blocks.text: Travel back to Nardah and speak to Ali the Wise.

blocks.html: After the cutscene, speak with Ali the Wise again.
blocks.text: After the cutscene, speak with Ali the Wise again.

needed.html: A ring of life and 1 backpack space
needed.text: A ring of life and 1 backpack space

blocks.html: Enter the nearby Uzer Mastaba pyramid.
blocks.text: Enter the nearby Uzer Mastaba pyramid.

substeps.html: To get there, either run north-east of Ali the Wise, use the nearby magic carpet network to get to Uzer and run south, or teleport to fairy ring DLQ and run east.
substeps.text: To get there, either run north-east of Ali the Wise, use the nearby magic carpet network to get to Uzer and run south, or teleport to fairy ring DLQ and run east.

blocks.html: Enter the pyramid, head north-west through the imposing doors, then south, down the stairs and talk to Senliten for oil in a canopic jar.
blocks.text: Enter the pyramid, head north-west through the imposing doors, then south, down the stairs and talk to Senliten for oil in a canopic jar.

substeps.html: Players who have completed certain quests can also choose to head directly to the Pharaoh Queen from the pyramid doors.
substeps.text: Players who have completed certain quests can also choose to head directly to the Pharaoh Queen from the pyramid doors.

blocks.html: Use (do not eat) your dwellberries and ring of life on the oil in a canopic jar to obtain a full canopic jar.
blocks.text: Use (do not eat) your dwellberries and ring of life on the oil in a canopic jar to obtain a full canopic jar.

blocks.html: Return to Ali the Wise and speak to him.
blocks.text: Return to Ali the Wise and speak to him.

substeps.html: If Leela is in the mummy's tomb, she can return you outside the Uzer Mastaba.
substeps.text: If Leela is in the mummy's tomb, she can return you outside the Uzer Mastaba.

blocks.caption: An example solution to the keypad puzzle, combination "EIHC" was used

needed.html: Either a macaw pouch or a ravenous locust pouch
needed.text: Either a macaw pouch or a ravenous locust pouch

needed.html: A method of grappling (either any crossbow and a mithril grapple, or an enhanced grappling hook on your toolbelt)
needed.text: A method of grappling (either any crossbow and a mithril grapple, or an enhanced grappling hook on your toolbelt)

needed.html: Enough summoning points to summon your familiar
needed.text: Enough summoning points to summon your familiar

blocks.html: Go to the Varrock Palace and speak to Hartwin (northwest tower, 2nd floor (UK) / 3rd floor (US)) to travel to Chaos Temple Dungeon.
blocks.text: Go to the Varrock Palace and speak to Hartwin (northwest tower, 2nd floor (UK) / 3rd floor (US)) to travel to Chaos Temple Dungeon.

blocks.html: Climb down the trapdoor.
blocks.text: Climb down the trapdoor.

blocks.html: Follow the path, opening three doors along the way.
blocks.text: Follow the path, opening three doors along the way.

blocks.html: Head east to the room with the range.
blocks.text: Head east to the room with the range.

blocks.html: Equip your insulated boots then enter the pipe on the south wall of the room.
blocks.text: Equip your insulated boots then enter the pipe on the south wall of the room.

blocks.html: Run through the sewers and attempt to enter the next pipe.
blocks.text: Run through the sewers and attempt to enter the next pipe.

blocks.html: Summon your familiar, interact with it and choose the remote view option.
blocks.text: Summon your familiar, interact with it and choose the remote view option.

blocks.html: Run to the room south of you, search all the tables for decoder strips and notes (k-z).
blocks.text: Run to the room south of you, search all the tables for decoder strips and notes (k-z).

blocks.html: Right-click pick-lock on the chest to obtain the code key.
blocks.text: Right-click pick-lock on the chest to obtain the code key.

blocks.html: Go north to the room east of the pipe and operate the keypad and solve the keypad puzzle:
blocks.text: Go north to the room east of the pipe and operate the keypad and solve the keypad puzzle:

substeps.html: First read the code key and memorise or write down the letters.
substeps.text: First read the code key and memorise or write down the letters.

substeps.html: Drag-and-drop strip #1 over the line indicated by the first letter of the code key (A, B, C...).
substeps.text: Drag-and-drop strip #1 over the line indicated by the first letter of the code key (A, B, C...).

substeps.html: The strip has a hole that reveals a specific number, this is the first digit of the passcode.
substeps.text: The strip has a hole that reveals a specific number, this is the first digit of the passcode.

substeps.html: Use the up and down arrows to enter that number, and press the right arrow to move to the next digit.
substeps.text: Use the up and down arrows to enter that number, and press the right arrow to move to the next digit.

substeps.html: Repeat this for the other three strips.
substeps.text: Repeat this for the other three strips.

blocks.html: Enter the room, equip your crossbow and mithril grapple, then grapple the pipe above you.
blocks.text: Enter the room, equip your crossbow and mithril grapple, then grapple the pipe above you.

blocks.html: Take from the pedestal for a heart in a canopic jar, then teleport out.
blocks.text: Take from the pedestal for a heart in a canopic jar, then teleport out.

blocks.html: Return to Ali the Wise and speak to him.
blocks.text: Return to Ali the Wise and speak to him.

blocks.html: Quest complete!
blocks.text: Quest complete!

items.html: Arrav can be faced in the Dominion Tower
items.text: Arrav can be faced in the Dominion Tower

items.html: The Tale of the Muspah

notes: The player can talk to Ali the Wise after the quest and give him additional information, but there are no rewards for doing so. To give him all the information, the player will need to have gathered the four tablets in the tunnel and the two notes of Mahjarrat (A-J and K-Z).
The player can also give him information from the following quests (if they had not been given already following Missing My Mummy):

Romancing the Crone - At Trollweiss Mountain
